'trigger' patterns. Steps run in order; 'onError' controls whether
a failing step retries, is skipped, or aborts the whole skill.

name: code-review
description: Review code changes for quality, security, and correctness

steps.description: Identify modified files from git diff or working tree
Check for anti-patterns, security issues, and style violations
Produce structured review output with findings and verdict
